selectionMethod: Outcome-first broad scan across overdose/infection prevention, treatment access, mental health, oral health, nutrition and benefit access, housing/temperature safety, child/domestic/sexual violence, disability, road safety and air pollution. Hypotheses are plausible research leads, not demonstrated high cost-effectiveness. Smaller direct-service, policy and referral organizations included alongside established clinical providers.
criticalFindings: Eating Disorder Foundation ended programs in July2026 and is excluded; Ardent Grove separately screened as current nonprofit provider.
Bicycle Colorado's original990 lists Denver Streets Partnership DBA; count one organization.
CHN Access Point and HeyDenver, JAG Institute, KIND Chopper Topper, and Ensight Curtis Strong Center are not extra organizations.
Stout Street Foundation and Coalition's Stout Street Health Center are different; only the latter belongs to Colorado Coalition for the Homeless.
Broad provider service areas often include Boulder/Weld; those counties are outside this MSA.
evidenceLimits: No estimated QALYs, full financial audit, current IRS/registry sweep, or donor-ready endorsements.
Current public service descriptions are treated as operational discovery evidence, not independently audited activity.
Search-index-only sources retained when direct pages failed; no repeated identical retries.
AllHealth Foundation/operating-network donor routing and Dental Lifeline national/local financial scope need alpha reconciliation.
Shared organizations may appear in CA/USA/SF but edition membership requires Denver evidence here; canonical aliases must reconcile centrally and time must not be reimported twice.

researchTime.allocation: No batch allocation, no idle time assigned, partial coverage

spaceSaver.method: Reused existing checkout/runtime; only compact JSON records, no dependencies/builds/servers/downloads. Retained start/closed timing evidence.
